title: Beginning of the Great Clone War
front_description: Standing in a Coruscant balcony, Chancellor Palpatine, Bail Organa, and Mas Amedda look down at the square below. There, tens of thousands of clone troopers are either drawn up in strict formation, or are moving forward in neat files to climb the ramps of waiting military assault ships. Everyone watches somberly as these ships take off and others just like them land in their place. The great Clone War has indeed begun.
back_description: Clone Troopers prepare for Galaxy-wide battle as the Sith's masterful scheme unfolds.
